title: RWB-S7-E6023-APP: the reconciliation step has no published operation, no posting-product operation or event name, no matching cross-reference, no plan C row for its three consumed services, no job or Schedule for its monthly trigger and no requirement row
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.3 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S7-E6023-APP; context pack S7 rwb-writeoff (service row, ownership rows, Architecture v5 slides 3, 4, 5, 8 and 13, Temporal and Drools slides 5, 12 and 13); legacy RWB-E6-023; FSD S7 Write-off and recovery v3 A2.11.1 to A2.11.4, Requirements served and Screens; TSD S7 Write-off and recovery v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1 and T-A; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-13, R-WO-15, R-WO-42 and R-WO-43; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-WOF-11 and row INT-16; Data Quality and Reconciliation Rules v3 row REC-06; Batch and Scheduling Design v4 row JOB-16; Event and Messaging Design v4 row EV-24
description: (1) No source publishes a REST operation for the reconciliation: TSD S7 T-A.1 lists only API-S7-001 POST /write-off-scans and API-S7-002 POST /write-offs/{writeOffId}/committee-decision, and the legacy Endpoints table of every S7 story repeats those same two rows, while FSD S7 A2.11.2 describes an unattended comparison with no actor screen. (2) The posted population is read through v_ace_write_off (FSD S7 A2.11.2; LDM v8 DF-ACE-261 to DF-ACE-269) but Architecture v5 slide 8 gives the 30 recovery.v_ace_* views to rwb-source-data as their only reader, so the read has to be a contract of P1; no operation name and no event name for that product is published in the API Specification, the Event and Messaging Design or the TSD. (3) The cross-reference that matches write_off.id to the posting write_off_key and account_key appears in no source, so the case-by-case difference list of R-WO-43 has no published matching key. (4) The plan gives H = RWB-S7-E6023-CON, RWB-PLT-E1027-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON with C, I and X empty, while the step consumes rwb-source-data, rwb-case and rwb-decision, so three consumed rows have no plan row. (5) DP-05 is absent from the pattern set of this key although the step compares ACE GL postings, and DP-09 and DP-10 are absent although the step consumes one event and signals the retention entry, so RWB-PLT-TE006-CON and RWB-PLT-E1071-CON are absent from the H row and no v_ace_* grant is claimed. (6) The monthly trigger has no job row: JOB-16 of the Batch and Scheduling Design v4 is the write-off scan, no reconciliation job exists, the TSD T5.1 external-interface table is empty, and no Temporal Schedule or event is named for the step. (7) R-WO-42 says publish completeness, but the Event and Messaging Design v4 catalogues only EV-24 WriteOffApproved for the service and no completeness event, and no read of a completeness result is published, so the path from this service to rwb-reporting has no element. (8) The TSD S7 T-A.2 gives the error set of the module as status codes with no message id per condition, so each condition is bound to a message of the legacy set plus MSG-P1-001 of VR-S7-011-1. (9) TSD S7 T4 prints the WRITEOFF rows up to R-WO-25 and then says and 26 more, so R-WO-42 and R-WO-43 have no printed row in the module technical specification. (10) The legacy acceptance criteria AC2 and AC3 are the approval transitions R-WO-13 and R-WO-15, which the split gives to RWB-S7-E6018-APP; they are owned here word for word because the legacy feature block carries them, and this story reads the APPROVED state they produce. (11) The eight REQ-S7 rows contain no row for reconciliation, although REQ-S7-005 names the publication of completeness as the requirement the step serves, and the plan's reqs row is empty.
evidence: TSD S7 T-A.1 two operations only; TSD S7 T5.1 empty; TSD S7 T4 rows R-WO-13 and R-WO-15 printed and 26 more unprinted; FSD S7 A2.11.2 integration points ALS and GL, Workbench; FSD S7 A2.11.3.1 rows VR-S7-011-1, R-WO-13, R-WO-15 and BR-S7-011; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-WOF-11 (read through v_ace_write_off) and row INT-16 (GL write-off postings in, into ACE, monthly); LDM v8 v_ace_write_off with DF-ACE-261 to DF-ACE-269; Architecture v5 slide 8 (30 recovery.v_ace_* views read only by rwb-source-data) and slide 13 (S7 row: Temporal to P7, Temporal and events to P8, REST and events to P1); Batch and Scheduling Design v4 rows JOB-04 and JOB-16; Event and Messaging Design v4 row EV-24; Data Quality and Reconciliation Rules v3 row REC-06; legacy RWB-E6-023 Endpoints, Permission checks, Validation and messages and Test cases
proposed: Fix the posting product and its event on the rwb-source-data contract, publish the matching cross-reference on the same contract, hold the three consumed rows as class C dependencies of the story, record no provided operation and no Schedule, and trace the step to REQ-S7-005 with the placeholder until the E6 BRD and the PRDs are written (C1).

title: RWB-S7-E6023-CON: the reconciliation baseline has no published operation, element, posting-product name, matching cross-reference or completeness element, and its consumed rows have no plan row
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.2 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S7-E6023-CON; context pack S7 rwb-writeoff; legacy RWB-E6-023; FSD S7 Write-off and recovery v3 A2.11.2, A2.11.3.1, A2.11.3.3 and A2.11.4; TSD S7 Write-off and recovery v2 T2, T3.0, T3.1, T3.2, T3.3, T4, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1 and T-A.1 and T-A.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-42 and R-WO-43; Data Quality and Reconciliation Rules v3 row REC-06
description: (1) TSD S7 T-A.1 publishes no reconciliation operation and the legacy Endpoints table repeats the scan and the committee decision for every S7 story, so the path, the operation id and the element names of a reconciliation read are in no source, and the baseline declares the step as a workflow branch with no operation. (2) No source publishes an OpenAPI element for the reconciliation result: the API Specification carries the WriteOff element only, the FSD records a result with no field list, and the approved and posted counts, the amounts, the difference and the tolerance are declared by this baseline as its own names. (3) The posted population is v_ace_write_off in the FSD, but Architecture v5 slide 8 gives every v_ace_* view to rwb-source-data as its only reader, and no source publishes the operation or the event that carries the product, nor its period and staleness elements beyond data_as_of. (4) No source publishes the cross-reference between write_off.id and v_ace_write_off.write_off_key, so the case-by-case match and the difference list have no published key. (5) TSD S7 T3.2 is an empty list-of-values table, so the baseline can publish no enumeration and derives the state values from TSD S7 T4 and the vocabulary already published by RWB-S7-E6017-CON. (6) TSD S7 T4 does not print R-WO-42 or R-WO-43, and the Batch and Scheduling Design v4 has no reconciliation job, so the period, the trigger and any Schedule element have no source. (7) R-WO-42 says publish completeness, and neither the Event and Messaging Design v4 nor any read publishes an element that carries it. (8) The plan's C, I and X rows of this slice are empty while the baseline declares four consumed rows across three services. (9) TSD S7 T-A.2 gives the error set as status codes with no message id per condition, so each condition is bound to a message of the legacy set.
evidence: TSD S7 T-A.1 operations API-S7-001 and API-S7-002 only, T-A.2 error lists 401, 403, 404, 409, 422 and 503 without message ids, T3.1 field list of DF-FIN-010 to DF-FIN-020, the empty T3.2 list table and T4 printed to R-WO-25 with 26 more; API Specification v4 WriteOff element with five required properties; FSD S7 A2.11.2 and A2.11.4.1 result with no field list; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-WOF-11 read through v_ace_write_off and row INT-16 monthly; Architecture v5 slide 8 and slide 13 S7 row; LDM v8 DF-ACE-261 to DF-ACE-269; Data Quality and Reconciliation Rules v3 row REC-06; context pack connection-matrix row S7 (Temporal to P7 and P8, REST and events to P1) and ownership rows
proposed: Publish the baseline with a placeholder on every unpublished name, declare the four consumed rows as class C dependencies, hold the result element as this baseline's naming, and confirm the posting product, its event and the matching cross-reference with the rwb-source-data owner before the baseline is tagged.
